===Glyph origin===
{{Han compound|林|攴|ls=ic|t1=trees, forest|t2=to knock, to tap}}, also written with hemp stalks [[𣏟]] (> [[𢽳]]) or bamboo [[竹]] instead of two trees. The original meanings are "to clear a place from vegetation; to kill". The character later started meaning "to dissipate, to disperse" since bamboo in particular breaks easily into pieces; eventually, the meaning shifted to "to walk around, to stroll".

This character is the original form of [[散]], originally written as [[𣀙]] as seen in the Shuowen Jiezi.

===Etymology===
From {{inh|zh|sit-pro|*sjwar ~ g/b-sjwa-n/t||flow; pour; scatter; spill; sow; broadcast}}. Cognate with {{och-l|撒|to cast away; to let go}}, {{och-l|宣|to spread; to proclaim}}, {{cog|bo|'''འཆོར'''་བ||to escape; to flow out}}, {{cog|my|သွန်||to pour out; to spill}}, {{cog|lhu|šē||to sow; to broadcast}}, {{cog|lhu|šêʔ||to pour; to spill; to disperse; to sow; to broadcast}}.
